prerequisite: First ReleaseSafe short strict record and same-ELF fresh passed, Debug short overflow remains preserved. Complete negative phase and archive its results before long execution.
purpose: Single original long >=32768 subsequent-frame qualification of strict notified recording, same optimized ELF and unchanged original long assertions; not a replacement by short8192.

parameters.REPO: Exact clean frozen source with verified 16 authored input files
parameters.ELF: Exact ReleaseSafe process-test executable from the successful optimized short recording and fresh replay; do not rebuild
parameters.TAPE_DIRECTORY: Fresh empty absolute local directory outside source
parameters.OUTPUT: Fresh local guard output directory outside source

executable.provenance: Exact ReleaseSafe executable already used for short recording/fresh. No rebuild.

prechecks: Exact source tree, clean worktree, ELF size/hash, runner hash and official Zig build provenance.
Verify all 16 fixture SHA values with --verify-only within 60 seconds.
Require output/tape directories unused; no controlled cross-frame, retry hook, delay or injection variables.

bounds.capture_bounds: Unchanged: existing finite lane capacity, max_capture_bytes and max_file_bytes; no expansion.
bounds.workload: Original unmodified long: real Play accepted/executed, then at least32768 subsequent frames before Stop submission; real Stop accepted/executed and Close. Original60second observation deadline, no timing hooks.

required_evidence: Actual Host uses notified_v1 and records pacing as canonical launch input and independent started reference.
No external timing hooks or generated output injection; actual source decoding and callback PCM.
Actual nonzero PCM and canonical Input/Schedule counts inspected from tape after recording; no outputs used as execution inputs.
Both commands accepted/terminal/executed and acknowledged; actual closed/joined state, provider opened=closed and zero source/lease/instance assertions.
Complete streaming seal, flush/sync/readback, strict admission and final history.bin; report identity and file hashes.
Source and fixture postcheck; guard child exit and real cleanup evidence, never infer cleanup solely from timeout absence.
failure_policy: One long recording only. Preserve overflow, runtime failure, strict unsupported-overlap, timeout and incomplete tape. No timing retries. No replay without complete admitted history. Unexpected outcome remains a failed or incomplete qualification, not a reason to shorten the original long oracle.
following: If admitted, separately freeze exact same-ELF independent fresh long replay. No broad extra matrix or Windows. Debug capacity failure remains explicitly unresolved regardless of result.
publication: Only source identities, plan and sanitized result. No raw logs, local paths, credentials, ELF, tape or audio binary. Main unchanged; no Windows or physical device action.
limits: Original long threshold retained >=32768; short earlier success not substituted.
Only optimized finite Linux null-backend scenario; not all concurrent histories or long-running physical audio.
Strict admission may reject unsupported overlap; preserve first outcome.
No source, capacity, timing hook or execution injection change.
